changelog: PANNING IS BACK ON PHONES AND TABLETS. Drag the battlefield with one finger and it moves with you. The camera rework that brought pinch-to-zoom and edge-stopping had quietly taken this away: the board used to scroll natively, the rework replaced that with a camera, and nothing took over the one-finger drag — so on a large map, anything outside the opening view simply could not be reached. Pinch to zoom is unchanged. Tapping is unchanged too, and that was the delicate part: a touch only becomes a drag once you have actually moved, so a slightly imprecise tap on a unit still selects it, and a drag that ends over a tile no longer selects that tile by accident.
